parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for flagging this. We understand your legal team is reviewing the DPA before you enable EU customer records, and they need confirmations regarding (1) subprocessors, (2) data retention, and (3) whether support logs can include customer identifiers.

We’ll route this to our privacy/compliance contact for human review. In the meantime, to make sure we provide the exact language your legal team needs, could you share:
1) The specific DPA provisions/sections they are reviewing (or any questions they’ve already drafted),
2) Whether they want confirmation for all support log types or only certain ones (e.g., ticketing system logs vs. debug/audit logs), and how “customer identifiers” should be defined for their review,
3) Any deadline you’re working against for enabling EU customer records.

Once we have that, we’ll coordinate a response back through the right privacy channel.
promised_actions: Route the request to the appropriate privacy/compliance contact for human review
Follow up with the customer for minimum clarifications needed to answer the legal team’s DPA questions
safety_notes: Do not promise a refund or specific outcome. This is a human-reviewed compliance/privacy clarification.
Avoid confirming specific subprocessors, retention periods, or logging behavior without the privacy team’s input.

parsed.customer_impact: Compliance/operational impact due to delay or inability to enable EU customer records until DPA clarifications are confirmed by the legal team.
